description: This file defines the interface for the DobbySpecGenerator class, which is responsible for generating runtime specifications (likely in JSON format) for containerized applications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for creating various plugin configurations and mounts, as well as utility functions related to system resources and configurations.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container runtime specifications based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the runtime specification based on the provided application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variables for the runtime specification.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates mount points for the runtime specification.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates RDK plugins configuration.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for minidump plugin.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for App Service SDK plugin.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates network plugin configuration.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount JSON object.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on the application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the system memory limit for the runtime.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves GPU memory limit.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU (Video Processing Unit) is enabled.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Retrieves the number of CPU cores available.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates configuration for classic plugins into the specification.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for Ethan Log plugin.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for Multicast Socket plugin.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates Ion Memory plugin configuration.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for Thunder plugin.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates OpenCDM plugin configuration.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates private data mount point configuration.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates mounts for FKPS.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount configuration.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a resource manager mount point.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Retrieves the working directory configuration.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes JSON configuration for Ion Heaps.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string.

methods.name: addHolePunchPortToSpec
methods.description: Adds hole punch port configuration to the spec.
